characters.summary: Captain Hook is a cunning pirate captain who relies on a rapier, a hook hand, and his crew to fight. He is cowardly when confronted by monsters like the Crocodile but ruthless against ordinary opponents.
weaknesses: Extreme phobia of the Tick-Tock Crocodile
limitations: Lacks one hand, replaced by a metal hook

sources.supports: General overview of Captain Hook, his weapons, and his fear of the crocodile.

feats.claim: Fought Peter Pan in a sword duel aboard the Jolly Roger.

notableResults.note: Defeated and forced to flee from the Crocodile.

unknowns: Exact proficiency with firearms varies between adaptations.

characters.summary: Charlie Brown is an ordinary, perseverant child who does not possess supernatural abilities or combat skills. He fights mainly through emotional endurance and dealing with everyday misfortunes.
weaknesses: Prone to failure when kicking footballs
limitations: Ordinary human child capabilities with no combat training or powers

sources.supports: General characteristics, role as a normal human child with no combat training.

feats.claim: Persistently attempts to fly a kite despite constant failure.

characters.summary: Cinderella is a kind-hearted young woman who relies on animal companions and magical assistance for extraordinary feats. In standard encounters, she has no offensive combat training.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to ordinary physical threats without magical protection

sources.supports: Background, plot, and reliance on fairy godmother's magic.

feats.claim: Attended the royal ball via magically summoned attire and carriage.

conditional.dependsOn: Fairy Godmother's spell lasting until midnight

campaignTags.claim: Receives magical transformation from her Fairy Godmother

characters.summary: Courage is a pink dog who overcomes extreme terror to protect his owners from bizarre monsters, aliens, and supernatural threats. He uses quick thinking, improvised gadgets, and cartoon physics to survive.

techniques: Improvised transformation into objects or animals
Computer research via the Nowhere Computer

weaknesses: Prone to panic and terror when facing paranormal entities
limitations: Speaks in garbled English and barks, limiting verbal communication

sources.supports: Overview of Courage's role, feats against supernatural monsters, and cartoon abilities.

feats.claim: Defeated various supernatural monsters and aliens threatening Eustace and Muriel.
feats.citation: Courage the Cowardly Dog television series

campaignTags.claim: Instantly darts away in extreme fear across vast distances
Uses the sentient Nowhere Computer to analyze threats

unknowns: Upper limits of his cartoon transformation abilities.

characters.summary: Daffy Duck is an energetic, eccentric waterfowl prone to schemes and explosive misfortune. He utilizes classic cartoon resilience and occasional props to counter adversaries like Bugs Bunny.

mechanisms: Cartoon regenerative resilience against physical trauma

weaknesses: Impulsive greed and hubris often lead to self-sabotage
limitations: Plans frequently backfire due to poor foresight

sources.supports: Overview of Daffy Duck's personality, cartoon physics, and rivalry history.

feats.claim: Survived point-blank explosions and projectile impacts with comedic recovery.

unknowns: Continuity variations between classic shorts and modern series.

limitations: Childhood maturity level and susceptibility to distraction

sources.supports: Details on Dash's superhuman speed and family abilities.

feats.claim: Ran across the surface of water and outran jungle mercenaries.

notableResults.note: Used speed to confuse and disable pursuers.

campaignTags.claim: Runs across the surface of water due to extreme velocity

characters.summary: Dexter is a boy genius who constructs advanced science fiction machinery, robots, and energy weapons in his secret laboratory. He relies heavily on prepared technology to handle threats.
weaknesses: Arrogance and vulnerability to having his inventions sabotaged by Dee Dee

sources.supports: Overview of Dexter, his laboratory, and his inventions.

feats.claim: Constructed giant robotic defenders to fight city-destroying monsters.

campaignTags.claim: Builds complex robotic and technological systems
Pilots customized robotic mecha suits for combat

unknowns: Reliability of experimental prototypes in high-stress combat.

characters.summary: Donald Duck is a volatile waterfowl who frequently flies into explosive rages, attacking foes with fists, blunt objects, and whatever weapons are at hand. He possesses cartoon durability.
weaknesses: Prone to uncontrollable fits of blinding anger
limitations: Loss of tactical reasoning when enraged

sources.supports: Overview of Donald Duck, temper tantrums, and slapstick history.

feats.claim: Fought off military service hazards and rival characters using sheer aggression.
feats.citation: Der Fuehrer's Face and classic Disney shorts

unknowns: Discrepancies between civilian cartoon shorts and action-oriented video game appearances like Kingdom Hearts.

limitations: Relies heavily on having workspace and tools to build advanced solutions

weaknesses: Easily frightened by dangerous threats or magical monsters
limitations: Physically limited to standard quadruped animal capabilities
